cleardevProduct.new: Plan a product and stages with Steward
cleardevProduct.intro: Discuss user outcomes first. Steward can inspect the repository and environment, clarify scope, and propose functional stages. Discussion does not start development.
cleardevExecution.effortHint: All project roles use the same tool, model and reasoning effort. Changing the model clears the previous effort choice.
cleardevExecution.modelHint: OpenCode requires the full provider/model identifier from your local configuration. No fallback model or provider will be selected.
cleardevExecution.rules: Discussion, planning, development and both review roles use one tool. The first discussion fixes the tool; the first role admission also fixes the model.
cleardevExecution.locked: The tool and model are fixed. Create a new project to use another tool.
cleardevExecution.legacy: This existing project retains Codex and its original role models. Historical sessions and evidence are unchanged.
cleardevExecution.unknown: The project selection or lock state has not been confirmed. Refresh before proceeding.
cleardevExecution.modelRequired: Choose a tool and an explicit valid model. An empty provider default is not accepted.
cleardevExecution.catalogHint: This catalog comes from your local tool. A listed model is not proof of remote authentication or available credit.
cleardevExecution.remoteUnknown: Remote service and quota remain unverified until an actual turn. Unknown means neither healthy nor out of credit.
cleardevExecution.authConfigured: Authentication information is configured but has not been verified.
cleardevExecution.authUnknown: Authentication information is not confirmed. Check and preserve your existing local configuration.
cleardevExecution.retryNotice: Continue the original workflow without replacing sessions, extending budgets, or granting human approval.
cleardevExecution.inactiveFailure: This failure is not the current actionable step. Refresh the workflow; historical or cancelled work cannot be retried here.
cleardevExecution.repair: Correct the model before first admission
cleardevExecution.savedModel: The model is saved. Prior failures are retained; retry the current preflight.
cleardevExecution.modelLocked: The model is fixed. Repair the local installation, authentication or service configuration before retrying; do not switch models here.
cleardevExecution.missingInstall: The selected tool was not found. Install it locally and make it available to ClearDev, then retry.
cleardevExecution.invalidConfig: Valid configuration could not be read. Repair your local tool or project configuration, then retry. Do not paste credentials here.
cleardevExecution.missingModel: The selected model is not listed. Correct it before first admission, or restore the provider configuration for an already fixed project.
cleardevExecution.unauthenticated: Authentication failed. Log in or repair your existing credentials in the local tool, then retry.
cleardevExecution.rateLimited: The service is rate limited. Wait until its retry time instead of sending repeatedly.
cleardevExecution.quotaExhausted: The provider explicitly reported insufficient credit. Check the account before retrying; ClearDev will not purchase services.
cleardevExecution.providerUnavailable: The tool or service check could not complete. Check installation, network and local configuration before retrying.
cleardevExecution.staleChoice: The project choice changed during inspection. This result did not admit a role; retry with the current choice.
cleardevExecution.unknownFailure: Preflight did not complete. Check the selected tool and local configuration, repair and retry. Unconfirmed state is not success.
cleardevProduct.name: Product name
cleardevProduct.retryNotice: The result is unconfirmed. Retrying reuses this request rather than starting another round.
cleardevProduct.reason.PRODUCT_STEWARD_U: The Steward session is temporarily unavailable. Input and the saved source are retained. Check recovery status below to continue the supported original step after repairing the environment; no new product is needed.
cleardevProduct.reason.PRODUCT_STEWARD_T: Observation timed out; this does not prove the message was never executed. Check the original session and recovery status. Unknown delivery or execution is not resent.
cleardevProduct.reason.PRODUCT_DISCOVERY: The Steward's reply could not be parsed. Continue the discussion and add any missing detail.
cleardevProduct.reason.PRODUCT_BASELINE_: The selected repository baseline changed. Refresh and choose the project starting point again.
cleardevProduct.reason.PRODUCT_EXECUTION: The selected execution tool or model is unavailable. Fix the local installation and authentication, then continue.
cleardevProduct.reason.PRODUCT_STAGE_CHA: The stage definition changed. Refresh and choose the stage again.
cleardevProduct.reason.PRODUCT_DISCUSSIO: No discussion rounds remain. Choose a stage or close the discussion.
cleardevProduct.reason.PRODUCT_PROJECT_U: The project is unavailable: archived or not a single-repository project. Choose another project.
cleardevProduct.reason.PRODUCT_DISCOVERY: Product discovery storage is temporarily unavailable. Refresh and retry.
cleardevProduct.reason.PRODUCT_REQUEST_C: The request content no longer matches the previous one. Refresh and retry.
cleardevProduct.thinking: Steward is investigating and responding. Discussion does not dispatch Planner or Builder.
cleardevProduct.frozen: The proposal was frozen when its first stage was prepared. Discussion and delivery history are retained.
cleardevProduct.discuss: Answer questions or revise the proposal before stage handoff
cleardevProduct.remaining: Remaining discussion rounds: {{count}}. Existing message and recovery budgets are not reset.
cleardevProduct.unsupported: This stage exceeds current execution capabilities. It can remain on the roadmap but cannot dispatch development.
cleardevProduct.prepareNotice: Preparation only creates a specification for native Electron approval. Later stages also require the previous delivery to complete and be explicitly selected as the baseline.
cleardevOperate.contract: This entry is for the existing mail workflow: one local, backward-compatible task advances after native specification confirmation. For other projects, use product discussion above, confirm the specification, and explicitly start project execution after planning. Closing the desktop preserves progress; it does not cancel work.
cleardevOperate.name: Requirement name
cleardevOperate.text: What to change, what not to change, and how to check it
cleardevOperate.busy: This project has an unfinished requirement. Resolve it before starting another.
cleardevOperate.created: Submitted. Follow the trusted progress below and the native confirmation dialog.
cleardevOperate.unknownSubmission: Do not submit again blindly. Refresh progress to check whether the server recorded this request; your input is retained.
cleardevProject.choiceAuthority: This records a product choice, not specification approval or permission to execute.
cleardevProject.evidenceAuthority: These are Steward-reported statements, not independently verified facts or executed checks. Only the repository binding above is observed by the backend.
cleardevProject.noEvidence: No investigation evidence has been recorded in this reply.
cleardevProject.basisAuthority: Agent-proposed planning inputs. The specification confirmation preserves these boundaries; none of these commands has been authorized or run by saving this proposal.
cleardevProduct.stale: Product and stage facts are out of date. Refresh to see current stages.
cleardevProduct.sourceChanged: The selected repository or code version has changed. Restore that source, or explicitly select the current project version before continuing. Existing plans are not current.
cleardevProduct.protocolFailed: Steward’s reply did not match the required format. The failed round and selected baseline are preserved. Enter the next goal to begin a new discussion in this product; it uses another round of the existing budget, not a retry or approval of the failed reply.
cleardevProduct.interrupted: The previous investigation was stopped because its source changed. Its failure and original proposal are preserved. Explicitly choose a current repository to start a new discussion; the interrupted turn will not be retried.
cleardevProduct.chooseHelp: Select a registered target and development basis. For an empty target, ClearDev downloads the selected source and verifies its exact version; no manual clone is required. Existing files are preserved. This does not approve development.
cleardevProduct.keepChoice: Keep the saved choice and discuss
cleardevProduct.projectsNone: No usable single-repository projects are registered. Create or import one using the project entry first.
cleardevProduct.choiceRejected: This choice was rejected before saving. Correct it or retry the same request.
cleardevProduct.historicalDelivery: Historical delivery — completed after final review
cleardevProduct.planAvailable: Engineering plan saved — ready for execution admission
cleardevProduct.planUnavailable: Engineering plan saved — execution not available

cleardevProduct.planningNotice: Prepare this stage for native specification confirmation and engineering planning only.

cleardevExecution.saved: Engineering plan saved. No development has started without explicit admission.
cleardevExecution.waiting: Waiting for a confirmed specification and saved engineering plan.

cleardevExecution.required: current plan, source and specification required

cleardevExecution.accepted: Admission request accepted. Reading persisted execution progress…
cleardevDelivery.changed: The final delivery changed. Refresh before selecting a baseline.
cleardevDelivery.receiptMissing: No selection receipt returned. Retry the same request after refreshing current facts.

cleardevDelivery.message: Use the completed delivery {{sha}} as the source for the next Stage discussion. Establish the next goal before preparing another specification; this choice does not authorize development.
cleardevDelivery.reason: Continue from this exact independently reviewed delivery.
cleardevDelivery.choose: Use this delivery for the next stage
cleardevDelivery.prepareData: Open this delivery once and complete its data migration before using it as another stage's baseline.
cleardevDelivery.selected: This exact delivery is the selected baseline. Continue the product discussion before preparing the next Stage.
cleardevDelivery.busy: A discussion or execution is still active, or the discussion budget is unavailable. No new baseline has been selected here.
cleardevDelivery.failed: The original request is retained; no new approval or completion is implied.
cleardevDelivery.stale: Product baseline facts are out of date. Refresh before selecting a delivery.

cleardevWorkbench.noTasks: The Planner has not created tasks yet.

cleardevReport.title: Title
cleardevReport.candidateReady: Candidate ready for checks and review
cleardevDiscussion.ready: A stage proposal is available. Before preparing a stage, check that its acceptance conditions express your goal.
cleardevDiscussion.discuss: The proposal is still being discussed. Answer the questions that affect the goal and acceptance before preparing a stage.
cleardevDiscussion.historical: This is the product discussion proposal. Confirmed specifications and delivery status are shown in each stage.
cleardevDiscussion.rounds: The number of rounds does not prove that discussion is complete. Review the acceptance conditions and proposed defaults; add business rules that would change the result.
cleardevDiscussion.counts: Questions to answer: {{questions}} · Proposed acceptance conditions: {{acceptances}} (inspect each stage)
cleardevDiscussion.assumptions: Defaults and assumptions proposed by Steward
cleardevDiscussion.noAssumptions: No defaults were listed separately. This does not prove there are none; check the acceptance conditions for implied rules.
cleardevRecovery.historyLoadError: Recovery history is temporarily unavailable. This stage remains completed.
cleardevRecovery.title: Resolve the blocker and continue
cleardevRecovery.supplement: Describe what you checked or what still needs to be resolved
cleardevRecovery.explanation: The responsible worker receives this context. Earlier stops and verdicts remain recorded; all original checks and acceptance still apply.
cleardevRecovery.builderSession: Recheck and restore the original development step
cleardevRecovery.sessionUnavailable: The original builder session identity or native recovery capability is unavailable. Restore the original connection first; history is preserved.
cleardevRecovery.reviewer: Add context and retry task review
cleardevRecovery.stage: Add evidence and retry stage trial
cleardevRecovery.budget: This role has no remaining budget. Request one extra turn, then submit your context after approval.
cleardevRecovery.unknown: The previous execution result is unknown. Restore the session connection and reconcile its result before retrying.
cleardevRecovery.limit: This task has used its extra turns. Reassess the plan; earlier failures and work remain recorded.
cleardevRecovery.stale: The specification, source or execution conditions changed. Refresh and resolve the current stop.
cleardevRecovery.accepted: Recovery request saved. Processing will continue; checks and acceptance have not yet passed.
cleardevRecovery.requestBudget: Request one extra turn (decide in the native window)
cleardevRecovery.budgetPending: Extra turn requested. Make the decision in the native window; the request itself does not clear the blocker.
cleardevRecovery.invalidBuilder: Keep existing work and continue the task
cleardevRecovery.optionalContext: Optional context (do not repeat requirements or errors)
cleardevRecovery.discussionHelp: Keep this round's input, selected source and original session. No new product or discussion round is created. The backend rechecks remaining attempts and failure evidence. Context is stored with the recovery, not added to the original input.
cleardevRecovery.compilationHelp: Keep the stage definition and acceptance criteria, using the original step's remaining attempt. Compilation still requires specification confirmation before development. Context does not rewrite the original compilation input.
cleardevRecovery.invalidBuilderHelp: The original working directory and unfinished changes are checked and retained. Continuing uses a new development round; original checks and independent review still apply. Leaving context empty sends the following instruction:
cleardevRecovery.defaultBuilderContext: Keep the original task, session and existing work. Continue under the original specification and return a valid result.
cleardevRecovery.loading: Loading recovery status for the original step…
cleardevRecovery.responseMissing: No complete recovery receipt was received. Check status before retrying the same request.
cleardevRecovery.nativeMissing: The original native session or message binding cannot be verified. A new session cannot impersonate recovery. Check the original connection and records.
cleardevRecovery.messagesExhausted: This step has used its original bounded attempts or messages. Only a separately offered extra-attempt request can seek native authorization. Input, counts, failures and work remain; changing identifiers cannot reset the limit.
cleardevRecovery.messagesUnknown: Historical message usage is unknown. A failure label cannot grant another send. Inspect the original session and evidence.
cleardevRecovery.sourceChanged: The discussion, stage or selected source changed. This old step cannot continue. Check the current product or stage source.
cleardevRecovery.preflightRequired: Preflight or message delivery is not complete. Resolve the preflight blocker shown on the page; this action cannot resend the message yet.
cleardevRecovery.retryNotDue: The provider's retry waiting period has not ended. Refresh later instead of creating another discussion.
cleardevRecovery.registered: Recovery is registered, but the new message has not been sent. Repair the original session or environment, then continue the same registration without adding an attempt.
cleardevRecovery.registrationMissing: Recovery registration does not match the available history. Refresh; do not create another request.
cleardevRecovery.requestUnconfirmed: The recovery request outcome is not confirmed. Its original identifier and complete content are retained for an identical retry.
cleardevRecovery.requestChanged: The step state changed, so this old request cannot be sent again. Refresh and inspect the saved recovery history.
cleardevRecovery.noAction: No safe recovery action is currently available. Input, failure records and existing work are retained. Inspect the original session, preflight or current stop reason.
cleardevRecovery.unsupported: This interface does not support the recovery action. Preserve the work and check the application version.
cleardevRecovery.unavailable: The backend has not enabled this recovery. Inspect its reason and refresh; do not bypass it by creating another request.
cleardevRecovery.historyNotice: This is a recovery registration and its original failure, not proof that checks or acceptance passed.
cleardevAutoPlan.title: Continue through the confirmed product plan
cleardevAutoPlan.scope: Confirm the whole plan once. Stages then plan, build and pass independent acceptance in order, using the preceding delivery. New features or changed goals and acceptance still require your decision.
cleardevAutoPlan.active: Whole plan confirmed. Remaining stages advance automatically after each preceding delivery.
cleardevAutoPlan.pending: Waiting for the native desktop confirmation of this whole plan.
cleardevAutoPlan.inactive: This plan is not authorized for automatic progression. Check the decision or discuss a revised plan.
cleardevAutoPlan.confirm: Confirm plan and develop stages automatically
cleardevAutoPlan.stageNotice: After whole-plan confirmation, this stage starts automatically when its predecessor has been accepted and delivered.
cleardevAutoPlan.unavailable: The plan confirmation receipt is unavailable.
cleardevFailure.title: Failure handling and ownership
cleardevFailure.action.repair: Repair the original task or artifact
cleardevFailure.action.observe: Reconcile the original action and evidence
cleardevFailure.action.stopped: Keep the original stop in effect
cleardevFailure.status.ready: Owner and disposition identified; source, authority and budget are checked again before dispatch.
cleardevFailure.status.human: Automatic continuation is not safe within the current authority. Resolve the issue below first.
cleardevFailure.status.waiting: Waiting for reliable evidence or authorized conditions; no blind resend.
cleardevFailure.status.registered: Recovery registered; delivery, checks and review are not implied.
cleardevFailure.status.repairing: The original task has entered repair; new checks and independent review are still required.
cleardevFailure.status.coordinating: The original Planner is handling the engineering agreement; coordination grants no extra authority.
cleardevFailure.status.verified: The successor completed the required checks and independent review; the original failure is preserved.
cleardevFailure.source: Original role associated with the source: {{role}}
cleardevFailure.evidence: Inspect exact source and reason code
cleardevFailure.stale: Source or connection changed. Current ownership and actions are unconfirmed; refresh the state.
cleardevFailure.boundary: Escalation does not expand authority. Restricted paths, permissions, product decisions and unknown execution results remain gated. Repair or coordination is not acceptance.
cleardevFailure.planningSourceChanged: The original discussion, stage or selected source changed. Refresh before continuing.
